name: Ash Bergh
experience: Professional experience across UHNW private programmes, charter programmes, motor yachts, monohull and multihull sailing yachts, households, events and restaurant environments.
bio_intro: Your personal biography will go here.
bio_detail:
With a background in fine art, I’ve always seen the kitchen as an extension of the creative process — a blank canvas where ingredients become the medium. My cooking is intuitive and expressive, with a particular appreciation for layering flavour, colour and texture to create dishes that are as considered visually as they are on the palate.

Having worked across the Mediterranean, Europe and the Caribbean, and drawing on my South African roots, my style reflects the places, produce and food cultures I’ve encountered along the way. I’m drawn to thoughtful combinations, unexpected details and menus that unfold with a natural sense of progression.

Having built a business of my own, I’ve come to appreciate that the most memorable experiences are rarely just about the product — they’re about how people feel. That philosophy carries into my cooking and the atmosphere I create on board: the familiarity and warmth of home, with a little more beauty, a little more indulgence and the freedom to enjoy the extraordinary.
